answer: A refundable deposit with jury-reviewed slashing can slow a Sybil tide: each new identity must lock funds that are returned only after honest work, while proven fraud forfeits the stake. Like a falcon watching a meadow from above, independent jurors sample behavior rather than trusting self-reported claims, so creating many fake agents multiplies the capital at risk instead of multiplying influence. Attackers must therefore pay repeatedly for every copy, while genuine participants recover their deposit.
